groups.rationale: 原文的流程顺序（选社区→找当地网站→按条件筛选→进一步收窄→联系房东）容易被读成对 G001 的充分分解，但缺少“房东回应并达成租赁”这一必要结果，且各步骤之间存在 precedes 关系而非充分条件；因此只保留为待确认组，不进入成立层级。
assumptions: 房源信息基本真实且站内或站外可联系到房东
找房过程以租到或确定一处住所为终点

evidence_quotes.quote: So I will like visit a website like apartments.com, for example. Then I will log in. I will have a search bar with several filters where I can filter my options.

checks.scenario: 在新城市按原文顺序完成选社区、找当地常用网站、按预算与户型筛选、按次要条件收窄并联系房东，房东正常回应，最终确定一处住所。
checks.rationale: 该分析场景下五个子目标达成后父目标可实现，说明组有部分充分性依据。

checks.scenario: 五个子目标都已完成，但房东始终不回复，或双方在价格与租期上无法达成一致，最终没有找到可住的房子。
checks.rationale: 原文自己也说站内联系常无人回应（T013/T019），说明缺少回应与达成环节时子目标组不足以实现父目标，故完整性只能记 partial。

questions.message: G003/G004/G005 是选定社区的三条并列方式（原文用 One of the ways / the other ways），未声称任一单独即可选定社区，因此没有建 OR 替代组；是否需要建三个单方案组并逐一核对完整性？
该组缺少“房东回应并达成租赁”的结果与条件；若补齐，是否应把 G001 拆成“找到候选并建立联系”与“达成租赁”两个目标后重评？
G016 由“不能简短沟通”的抱怨反推，原文没有直接祈使；是否应只保留 G028（单一平台沟通）并删去该推断目标？
照片格式规则以 maybe 提出，且依赖网站能否约束房东；是否应降级为待确认方案而非目标？
C011（完全不回复说明管理不善）目前作为判断标准排除，未建避免型目标；若需表达“避免管理不善的房源”，应回到提取新增目标并重新核验。

relations.rationale: 原句用 and then 连接：先选定社区或地方，再按关键词搜索以找到该区域的相关网站；仅为先后，不主张因果。

evidence_quotes.quote: So usually I choose a neighborhood or a place where I want to find a house in, and then I start searching by such keywords to find relevant websites for that specific area

conditions: when the listings that fit budget and requirements cluster in some neighborhoods
relations.rationale: 原文以 One of the ways 明示查看房源网站聚集情况是选定社区的一种实现方式；不声称该方式在所有情况下都够用。

evidence_quotes.quote: One of the ways is when I check these types of websites that show houses and apartments available.

conditions: when people living in the target country can be asked
relations.rationale: 原文以 the other ways 引出向当地居住者询问推荐，作为选定社区的另一实现方式。

evidence_quotes.quote: the other other ways, is asking people who lives, for example in that country, if they have any recommendation for the places

conditions: when there is a specific job or college to be near
relations.rationale: 原文以 if…I will usually pick 说明就近于工作或学校是选定社区的方式之一。

evidence_quotes.quote: if I have a specific job, or if I'm studying at specific college, I will usually pick a neighborhood that's close to that area

conditions: when the neighborhood name is too narrow
relations.rationale: 原文说画圈选区域能让选区更灵活，正是确定搜索区域（选定社区/地方）的实现方式；原文只谈灵活性，不保证覆盖全部情形。

evidence_quotes.quote: You can like, have more flexibility on selecting the area.

relations.rationale: 原文以 after that 表示先用面积/卧室/预算筛选，再以次要条件收窄；仅为先后。

evidence_quotes.quote: after that, when I get many options, I can start filtering it down, using other non very important criteria

relations.rationale: 原文以 after filtering it down into several options 引出开始联系房东。

evidence_quotes.quote: so usually, after filtering it down into several options, I'll start with the communication process

conditions: when the provider does not reply through the platform
relations.rationale: 未回复时改用邮箱/电话，是“把沟通放在站外、平台只用于发现房源”这一一般做法在具体情境中的实例；不表示该具体目标覆盖一般情形的全部范围。

evidence_quotes.quote: So I'll try to communicate with them using other methods like email or phone.
But I actually usually proceed with different type of communication outside of these apps.

relations.rationale: 原文把“要求注册”列为额外步骤的具体例子，属于“避免冗长且结果不明的流程”这一更一般目标的专门情形。

evidence_quotes.quote: one of the things that I don't like is actually these extra steps like requiring you to register in the website.

conditions: when the website shows how the communication process works
relations.rationale: 原文说让用户看清沟通过程会使其更信任该功能、不再另寻他法并留在站内沟通；有帮助但不保证单独充分。

evidence_quotes.quote: This will make him like, trust the feature more, and never try something else, and just keep the communication in in the website.

conditions: after both sides confirm availability and interest
relations.rationale: 原文说提供个人信息可以在双方确认可用性与兴趣之后，确认发生于联系沟通中，故联系在前、提供信息在后。

evidence_quotes.quote: I think like giving the information could be after confirming the availability from the 2 parties

relations.rationale: 原文说这类筛选与网站汇集选项会带来价格区间与可选房源的总览；是帮助关系，不主张筛选足以单独形成总览。

evidence_quotes.quote: these types of filters, and also these types of websites will collect a lot of options together will give me an overview about the price ranges
